name: caol.reference_camp_gear_reentry_focused_mcw
description: Owner-reference continuation for actual day patrol service and comparable physical source conditions, starting from the previously observed post-transfer saved world.

forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, lead, dispatch, encounter, clock, payment or return injection

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Continue from the exact native saved reference camp. Use ordinary job, door, window and fuel controls as disclosed setup; observe actual day patrol roster and service and bounded physical open/closed/roof source conditions with time, weather, geometry, fuel and observer opportunity. Save and close the actual result. A separately authorized continuation from that fresh saved output is required to observe service after reload.
proof_targets: source and installed world identity, player, camp, actor and actual game time
actual day patrol roster and physical duty service
actual open/closed/roof source and observer conditions with light escape and smoke positions kept separate, reusing scoped original reference observations
native save and exit with exact saved-world identity for a separately reviewed service-after-reload continuation
invariants: saved start and ordinary camp/window/door/fuel setup are zero-credit; prior transfer and night/physical observations retain their original run identities
do not inject NPC action, perception, source response, clock, lead or other actor state
do not claim native use of the original closed archive when modifying this open reference working copy
do not claim service after reload until a fresh resulting native save is reopened through a separately authorized source-bound continuation
